Both the learned counsel appears physically before this Court.

sentences.text:
3. Arguing the matter, learned counsel for the appellant states that the appellant is left with disability of 15% in respect of whole body, but the tribunal has not granted any compensation towards loss of future earnings and aggrieved by the same, present appeal is filed.
NC: 2026:KHC:6208 HC-KAR 4.

Vehemently opposing the submission thus made, learned counsel for respondent No.2 submits that the appellant neither produced the disability certificate nor examined any person who assessed the disability.
Learned counsel states that the appellant produced Ex.P9 - outpatient record where the disability is mentioned as 15%.
Learned counsel contends that it is not known who assessed the disability and on what basis.
Learned counsel further submits that exorbitant amount is granted as compensation under each head and thus appeal is not maintainable.
5. The submission that is made by learned counsel for respondent No.4 is that liability is fixed upon respondent No.2 only.

6. Learned counsel for the appellant fairly admits that neither the disability certificate is produced nor any evidence is produced to show that the disability in respect of whole body is 15% as contended by the appellant.
NC: 2026:KHC:6208 HC-KAR 7.

The tribunal granted a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- under the head of pain and suffering, Rs.13,718/-
towards medical expenses, Rs.5,000/- towards travelling expenses, Rs.50,000 towards future treatment, Rs.2,00,000/- towards mental agony and Rs.25,000/- towards attendant, food and nourishment expenses.
Appellant took treatment as inpatient only for a period of three days.

Considering the nature of injuries sustained and the period of treatment taken, this Court is of the view that the amount granted as compensation by the tribunal under each head is highly justifiable and thereby there are no grounds for further enhancement.
Therefore, this Court ultimately holds that the appeal lacks merits.

Hence, the following:
ORDER
The appeal stands dismissed.
